metadata.value: The Open Datasheets framework is a simple, standardized no-code way to document datasets. It is inspired by the concept of [datasheets for datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.09010) and [Understanding Machine Learning Practitioners' Data Documentation Perceptions, Needs, Challenges, and Desiderata](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3555760) research papers. The framework is designed to be both machine-readable and human-readable, serving as a tool for dataset creators to document their datasets and for dataset consumers to understand the datasets they are using.
